properties.name: Withlacoochee River PUD
properties.utilities: No public water / no public sewer reported
properties.summary: Rare riverfront acreage with advertised PUD zoning and strong Old Florida recreational appeal. Legal access, buildable acreage, utilities, and the controlling PUD documents decide whether it can become a clean destination fish camp or merely very attractive wet dirt.

criticalDueDiligence.text: Confirm legal and commercial access; listing directions reference an easement and entry from Kennesaw Road.
Determine buildable acreage after AE floodplain, wetlands, setbacks, stormwater, and river-buffer requirements.
Obtain the controlling PUD ordinance or development order and written confirmation that the intended RV destination use is permitted.
Price commercial well, wastewater treatment, or septic feasibility before assigning a realistic site count.

properties.name: Improved 40-Acre Retreat
properties.locationAccuracy: Approximate marker pending parcel GIS verification
properties.utilities: Well, septic, electric, and one RV hookup reported
properties.summary: Large, inexpensive tract with existing well, septic, electric, pole barn, bathhouse, and RV hookup. It lacks a confirmed natural destination draw, but it offers one of the cheapest phased-start platforms currently in the queue.

criticalDueDiligence.text: Confirm whether commercial RV campground or destination use is permitted or realistically approvable.
Verify floodplain, wetlands, soils, and usable acreage before assuming the full 40 acres can be developed.
Determine whether the existing well and septic can support anything beyond private recreational use.
Evaluate whether nearby attractions and traffic can support a destination business rather than a hunting camp.

properties.name: 40-Acre Mini Farm near I-10
properties.locationAccuracy: Approximate marker pending parcel GIS verification
properties.floodZone: Unknown; pond and lowland review required
properties.utilities: Residence and farm utilities present; commercial capacity unknown
properties.summary: Forty acres with mature oaks, pasture, ponds, an existing residence, and proximity to Madison and I-10. It has character and operational head-start potential, but the ponds, transmission corridor, easements, and commercial entitlement path need scrutiny.

criticalDueDiligence.text: Confirm zoning, future land use, and whether transient RV or campground use is permitted or approvable.
Map ponds, wetlands, floodplain, transmission line impacts, and any tower or access easements.
Determine safe and commercially acceptable road access for large RVs.
Assess whether I-10 visibility and nearby recreation provide enough guest demand for the intended concept.

properties.name: 47-Acre Multi-Use Farm
properties.locationAccuracy: Approximate marker pending parcel GIS verification
properties.floodZone: Advertised high and dry; independent verification required
properties.summary: The largest tract in the current queue, advertised as high and dry with irrigated acreage and existing improvements. Strong expansion flexibility, but it needs a compelling destination story and a verified entitlement path before it outranks waterfront or recreation-driven sites.

criticalDueDiligence.text: Confirm zoning and the likelihood of approval for a commercial RV destination or campground.
Independently verify the high-and-dry claim, wetlands, soils, and stormwater constraints.
Determine whether existing irrigation, well, septic, and power infrastructure can contribute to phased commercial development.
Identify a strong local attraction or experience capable of making this more than an overnight stop.
